# pidginhost_server (Data Source)

Looks up an existing server by `id` or `hostname` (exactly one).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_server" "db" {
  hostname = "db-1"
}

output "db_private_addresses" {
  value = data.pidginhost_server.db.private_networks[*].address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Hostname. It must match exactly one server (case-insensitive).
- `id` (String) Server ID.

### Read-Only

- `cpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
- `destroy_protection` (Boolean) Whether destroy protection is enabled.
- `disk_size` (Number) Boot disk size, as reported by the API.
- `generation` (String) Hardware generation.
- `ha_enabled` (Boolean) Whether high availability is enabled.
- `image_name` (String) The installed image, as reported by the API.
- `ipv4_address` (String) Primary public IPv4 address, if any.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Primary public IPv6 address, if any.
- `memory` (Number) Memory, as reported by the API.
- `package` (String) Server package, as reported by the API.
- `power_state` (String) Power state (`running` or `stopped`), or null if the API did not report it.
- `private_networks` (Attributes List) Private network interfaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_networks))
- `project` (String) Project label.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status (`active`, `provisioning`, ...).
- `username` (String) Default login user.

<a id="nestedatt--private_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_networks`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Address of the server in the network.
- `interface` (String) Interface name.
- `network` (String) Network, as reported by the API.
